d: An Iranian singer has been sentenced to 74 lashes for a music video that authorities labelled obscene and immoral. Parastoo Ahmadi and four members of her production team have also been banned from musical activities and foreign travel for two years. But this is part of a much bigger crackdown. From the death of Mahsa Amini and the 'Woman, Life, Freedom' protests to mass arrests and surveillance under Iran's Noor Plan, the regime has spent decades trying to enforce compulsory hijab laws. Yet Iranian women continue to defy them. Why is the regime struggling to control what women wear?
